text: In Nagel's model of reduction, a higher-level theory reduces to a lower-level theory when its laws are derivable from the lower-level laws together with ___ laws connecting the vocabularies of the two theories.
explanation: Nagelian reduction requires connectability plus derivability: bridge laws link each higher-level predicate to lower-level predicates (e.g., temperature to mean molecular kinetic energy), so that the higher-level laws follow logically. The multiple realizability argument attacks precisely the assumption that strict, non-disjunctive bridge laws are available.
